changes.comment: Translates the five sections the Spanish README was missing: slices that hold a single value, `""` against `"**"` for watching a whole slice, saving and restoring state, lists that reorder, and what that costs when measured. The English README carried 44 headings and the Spanish 39, so a reader in Spanish had no documentation at all for root-value slices, for persistence and hydration, or for the entity adapter, which is the answer to the reordering cost the English text spends two sections on. The deduplication and cascade-protection sections were also in the opposite order from the English and now follow it. Heading count, nesting level and order are identical between the two languages.
